text: Large Telegram dumps bigger than the fixed 5-chunk vitaSave/vitalearn path use /vitamothergenesis (plain 0-ETH self-txs, N batches as needed, reader key MGPLAIN.<strand>) or /vitamotherGenesisencoded (AES-GCM chunks + mg-loc-commitment-v1 zero-proof of locations, two-part MG1/MG2 key). /encodegenesisreveal pulls sealed locs and reconstructs. Does not replace or mute vitaSave/inscribeChunk mother brain.
